comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. What the manual says about the Bass and Treble knobs does not match this build: it describes a Baxandall EQ circuit, and while BaxandallEQ.cpp is in the tree and is compiled, ChowDer.cpp never instantiates it. The knobs go to a ShelfFilter whose crossover is 600Hz and whose gains are the knob times 9dB with 20dB subtracted, so there is a fixed 20dB of attenuation before the drive stage. Drive is the knob times 30dB and Bias is the knob times 2.5 added as a constant. A 30Hz high-pass follows the clipper.
